Policy 2: first select ace of diamonds, ace of hearts; then select the last object in the order of the two remaining objects.
Policy 3: first select ace of spades, ace of clubs; then select the first object in the order of the two remaining objects.
Policy 4: first select ace of spades, ace of clubs; then select the last object in the order of the two remaining objects.
